_about: The case summary (datalayer/summary/). Edit and re-render; no code changes.
notes_model reads each selected document and takes structured notes; writer_model turns
the notes into the plain-English summary. Prices come from claims_config.json's prices table.
budget_usd is this feature's own cap, separate from the claims analysis and Next actions. A run
stops before a model call that could take the total in costs_csv past it, and asks for
re-authorization (raise budget_usd here) rather than carrying on.
max_answer_groups: answers filed by the same counsel count as one group; this many groups are
read, the rest listed by name. max_rulings: dispositive rulings read (grants before denials,
then newest); the rest listed.
read_pages: how much of each kind of document is read -- its first and last pages. The
complaint's body only (never its exhibits or appendices); an answer's opening and its
affirmative defenses, which come at the end; a final ID's summary and its conclusions.
complaint_body_min_pages: before a complaint is downloaded, the first attachment at least this
long is taken to be its body (cover letters come first); once on disk, page 1 decides.
estimate: the token counts the cost preview assumes. tokens_per_page is for dense legal text;
prompt_tokens is the instructions sent with each document.
max_output_tokens: the most each call may write. The budget check assumes a call writes this
much, so a run never goes past budget_usd.
notes_version: bump it to take every document's notes again (paid again) after changing the
notes prompt; notes taken under another version are not reused.
